name: Neural Biometric Attributor (GAN Fingerprint)
description: A neural-scale biometric reactor core. Midjourney, StyleGAN, and DALL-E are not omnipotent deities; they are flawed computational bots. Every time they regurgitate a synthetic masterpiece, the internal Upsampling network architecture involuntarily vomits an undeniable, highly distinct microscopic wave trace (Checkerboard/Frequency Drops). Plunging an image into this rigorous filter doesn't merely declare 'Forgery'—it brutally doxes the exact computational bastard that hallucinated it (identifying ProGAN, StyleGAN2, or StarGAN respectively).
algorithm: Spatial Anomaly Network Core Fingerprinting (PRNU Analog)
mechanism: Functioning exactly as a fired bullet scores distinct ballistic rifling on its casing. When churning pixels through deep Convolutional models, the GAN network imprints a uniquely persistent digital 'Fingerprint' buried deep within the Mid-High frequencies. This algorithm aggressively scrubs the subjective visual content (wiping out the human faces and buildings) using hyper-denoising filters purely to exhume the bare neural 'gunpowder residue'. It hurls this residue into a machine-learning fingerprint registry, and upon a hit... the synthetic imposter is utterly destroyed.
parameters: Morphology Sweep: High-Pass Denoising Filters (Neural Extractor), Arsenal: Fingerprint Dictionary Correlation Matching, Tribunal: Cross-Source Attribution Thresholds
accuracy: Staggering Apex (90-98%) - Utterly annihilates and unmasks the arrogant, sweeping army of classical GAN-generated visual deepfakes.
source: Yu et al. & Marra et al. - Attributing Fake Images to GANs / Unmasking DeepFakes
useCase: Brings the executioner's sledgehammer violently crashing down upon supposed artistic masterpieces and ghostly synthetic CV headshots. It irrefutably proves not only the image's plastic nature but violently extracts the manufacturer label responsible (e.g., 'Manufactured by Asian StyleGAN clone').

references.title: Yu, N., et al. (2019). Attributing fake images to GANs: Learning and analyzing GAN fingerprints. ICCV.

strengths:
• Undefeated and violently aggressive when launching targeted manhunts to 'Attribute' the precise Genesis network (e.g., discovering the exact ProGAN iteration), a feat archaic boolean 'Fake/True' radars fundamentally cannot comprehend.
• Operates entirely Blind—requiring absolutely zero authentic reference comparison. Simply dropping the raw image into the reactor triggers a definitive legal conviction.
limitations:
• The precision blade shatters into pieces when confronting the apex-tier Diffusion monsters (Midjourney V6/Flux) and advanced Transformers. These newer architectures construct images via entirely alien Denoising paradigms, washing their hands 100% clean of filthy classical GAN fingerprints.
• The radar jams completely if a malicious actor employs dark-arts tactics (Adversarial Noise Poisoning) or aggressively resizes the file, shredding the forensic fingerprint into garbage data that fools the correlation engine.
